channel.title: Buckets Blog
channel.description: A blog about budgeting with Buckets

item.title: Buckets by the Loaf: Now Simpler!
item.description:
Four years ago, we launched an experiment offering Buckets licenses worldwide at a cost of about 20 loaves of bread in the country where you live. From the small initial group of countries, it’s grown to be available in over 70 countries. Buckets is now all over the world! And starting today, the process for buying a “by the loaf” license is much simpler.
Photo by Helen Ast on Unsplash

item.title: Aug 2025 Update
item.description: Here’s a quick update on the latest with Buckets. It’s been a busy summer and I’m excited to get back to working on fixing bugs, adding features and getting the mobile apps closer to complete.

item.title: Budgets, Budgets Everywhere!
item.description:
Happy New Year! I’m very excited to announce the beta release of Buckets v0.73.0 which includes two major features:
  1. Budgets from different devices can now be merged together
  2. You can now share budgets using a shared network folder
Buckets is one step closer to working seamlessly on mobile!
Photo by Lance Grandahl on Unsplash

item.title: Why Buckets?
item.description:
Buckets is a good budgeting app, but it’s not the only app. There are probably hundreds of apps for managing your money. I don’t like to pick on other apps, because honestly, if it works for you that’s great! I’m happy when people are financially successful. However, Buckets is unique in a few ways that I’d like to highlight. And most of these have very little to do with budgeting.
Photo by Rupert Britton on Unsplash
